description: In the Webots robot simulator, change the gravity from Earth (9.81) to Mars (3.72) via the WorldInfo node, then save the world to a new file.

natural_language.prompt: In the Webots robot simulator that is currently open, you need to change the gravity setting to simulate a Mars environment. In the scene tree on the left side of the window, click on the 'WorldInfo' node to expand it. Find the 'gravity' field which is currently set to 9.81. Click on it and change the value to 3.72 (Mars gravity) in the field editor panel that appears below the scene tree. After making the change, save the world file using File > Save World As... and save it to /home/ga/Desktop/mars_gravity_world.wbt.
